verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator. Its ecosystem consists of compute runtimes, libraries, and management and monitoring tools (ROCm, AMD SMI, Omnistat, the metrics exporter). None of these is an end-user application where data is analyzed to produce AI-generated insights, so 'insights from my data inside the product' is an application-layer axis that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows such a feature shipping. The Spur scheduler is described as 'AI-native', but it schedules jobs and does not generate insights from data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
